project_type: React 19 SPA (Vite) + Django 5 REST API, SQLite, single-repo monorepo
build_system: Vite 8 for frontend (npm run build in frontend/); Django manage.py for backend. No workspace tooling — run commands separately in each subdirectory.
test_framework: None configured. Verification is done via build (npm run build) and Django system check (python manage.py check).
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm run build' in d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\frontend — must exit 0. 2. Run 'python manage.py check' in d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\backend — must report 0 issues. 3. Start dev server with 'npm run dev' (frontend) and 'python manage.py runserver' (backend) to smoke-test routes manually.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Use --legacy-peer-deps when installing npm packages (React 19 peer dep conflicts). Backend SQLite db at backend/db.sqlite3 — do NOT run destructive migrations. npm install commands must run in frontend/ directory.
contribution_requirements: Do not delete HealthActivity or GardenProgress models. Do not duplicate the chatbot, drug-interaction engine, or any existing feature. All new files under frontend/src/pages/digital-twin/. No fabricated patient data. Hypothetical values in HealthChangeExplorer never saved. 3D models labelled as illustrative only.
key_patterns: 1. Pages inject sidebar content via useContext(SidebarContext) → setSidebarContent(jsx) in a useEffect with cleanup. 2. Auth guard pattern: user && user.role === 'Patient' ? <Component /> : <Navigate to='/auth' />. 3. API calls use the 'api' axios instance from services/api.js (baseURL http://127.0.0.1:8000/api, auto JWT injection). 4. Lucide React icons throughout. 5. Bootstrap utility classes + custom CSS vars (--accent-teal, --text-primary, --bg-card, --border-color). 6. font-monospace class for labels. 7. glass-card class for panels. 8. theme-general / theme-heart / theme-diabetes / theme-cancer CSS class pattern on page root div. 9. Framer Motion for animations. 10. isSidebarPage in App.jsx drives sidebar visibility — must include 'digital-twin'. 11. Backend views use @api_view + @permission_classes([IsAuthenticated]) decorator pattern from DRF.
directory_structure: frontend/src/pages/ — all page components; frontend/src/pages/dashboard/ — PatientDashboard.jsx and DoctorDashboard.jsx; frontend/src/pages/profile/ — decomposed Profile tab components; frontend/src/components/ — shared components (AIChatbot, VoiceExplainer); frontend/src/context/ — React contexts (SidebarContext, ThemeContext, useTheme); frontend/src/services/ — api.js (axios instance), utils.js (helpers + INTERACTIONS); backend/medical/ — Django app with views.py, models.py, urls.py, garden_views.py, diet_views.py
